title: Managed Database: high availability multiplier
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database high availability multiplier is specified by contracted tier. Primary node usage multiplier for synchronous high availability; decimal. Read replica node rate factor relative to primary usage; decimal.

| Contracted tier | High availability multiplier | Read replica multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 1.95 | 0.9 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 1.95 | 0.9 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 1.95 | 0.9 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 1.95 | 0.9 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 1.95 | 0.9 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 1.95 | 0.9 |

## Tier comparison
For high availability multiplier, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 1.95.
